title: Words Speak Louder Than Code: Investigating Cognitive Heuristics in LLM-Based Code Vulnerability Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Manipulating author attribution metadata in the prompt context (e.g., high-prestige principal security engineer vs. low-prestige junior developer) to evaluate its impact on vulnerability detection verdicts.

Varying the task directives in the prompt using consequence framing (highlighting gains of correct identification vs. losses of missing a vulnerability) and goal framing (verifying compliance vs. identifying violations) to measure changes in model outputs.

Providing prior automated security analysis results (e.g., explicitly marked SAFE vs. VULNERABLE, or implicitly passed vs. did not pass) in the prompt context to test if the model anchors to the prior verdict.
